name: kanera
description: Plan work, update cards, and keep track of project progress in Kanera.

interface.longDescription: Keep your projects moving with Kanera. Find out what needs attention, catch up on recent changes, and turn plans into cards and checklists. Update work, add comments and notes, organise what to tackle next, and get a clear picture of progress across your boards. Connect your Kanera account to get started. You can view and update work according to your existing Kanera permissions.
defaultPrompt: Find a Kanera card by its key and summarize its status and recent activity.
Summarize my active Kanera work and flag blockers.
Find overdue Kanera cards assigned to me.
